Systems · Cybersecurity · Cloud · DevOps · Networking · AI

Select a domain to access hands-on manuals, reference architectures, and step-by-step courses.

⚙️ Active Track DevOps & CI/CD

Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and automated pipeline orchestration.

Explore DevOps → 🐧 Core Systems Linux Administration

Kernel tuning, systemd, eBPF, BASH scripting, ZFS/Btrfs storage, and server hardening.

AD DS, Kerberos, PowerShell automation, GPO, Hyper-V, WDAC, and replication troubleshooting.

Explore Windows → ⚔️ Offensive Red Team & Pentesting

Active Directory exploitation, web pentesting, privilege escalation, Wi-Fi security, and C2 frameworks.

Explore Red Team → 🛡 Defensive Blue Team & DFIR

Incident response, SIEM rule engineering (KQL/Sigma), threat hunting, EDR operations, and forensics.

Explore Blue Team → ☁️ Multi-Cloud Cloud Architecture

AWS/Azure/GCP architectural patterns, Entra ID, Serverless computing, and FinOps optimization.

Explore Cloud → 🌐 Telecom Networking & SD-WAN

BGP routing protocols, Wi-Fi 6E engineering, Wireshark packet analysis, SD-WAN, and SASE.

Explore Networking → 💻 Software Eng Software Engineering

Microservices patterns, Clean Architecture, DDD, REST/gRPC standards, async Python, and Rust.

Explore Development → 🗄️ Data Stores Database Administration

PostgreSQL performance tuning, MongoDB sharded clusters, Redis caching, and ClickHouse analytics.

Explore Databases → 🤖 Emerging Tech AI Engineering & MLOps

Local LLM deployment, RAG architectures, Vector DB operations, LangGraph agents, and MLOps pipelines.

Explore AI/ML → 📈 Reliability SRE & Observability

SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, Prometheus metrics, and Grafana dashboards.

Explore SRE → 🔐 Identity Zero Trust & Security

Keycloak IAM, HashiCorp Vault secrets engine, OAuth2/OIDC specifications, and enterprise PKI.

Explore Zero Trust →

docs.title: What Are Cookies?
docs.text:
Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser to retain technical state, preferences, and session information.

This page outlines how ITSTCK (itstck.com) utilizes cookies and local storage technologies in compliance with European Union ePrivacy Directive and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR / EU 2016/679) guidelines.

docs.title: 1. Essential Preference Cookies (Strictly Necessary)
docs.text:
These cookies are technically required to operate the site's explicit functionality, such as storing your privacy options. They do not track personal data.

  • Name: itstck_consent
  • Purpose: Stores your explicit cookie banner acceptance or management choices so the banner does not re-appear on every page request.
  • Provider: ITSTCK
  • Duration: 12 months
  • Legal Basis: Legitimate interest / Strictly Necessary under ePrivacy Directive (art. 5.3). Consent is not required.

docs.title: 2. Google Analytics (Performance & Analytics — Optional)
docs.text:
These cookies collect aggregated and anonymized statistical information about website traffic, visitor interactions, geographical region, and device performance metrics.

  • Names: _ga, _ga_*, _gid, _gat
  • Purpose: Analyzes audience interaction to help improve technical content and platform usability. IP anonymization (anonymizeIp) is active by default.
  • Provider: Google LLC / Google Ireland Limited
  • Duration: Up to 2 years
  • Legal Basis: Explicit user consent (GDPR Art. 6.1.a).

Note: Analytical scripts will only execute after you explicitly grant consent via the consent banner.

docs.title: 3. Security & Infrastructure Cookies (Strictly Necessary)
docs.text:
• Names: __cf_bm, cf_clearance
  • Purpose: Distinguishes genuine human visitors from automated botnets, mitigates DDoS attacks, and ensures edge security delivery.
  • Provider: Cloudflare, Inc.
  • Duration: Session up to 1 year
  • Legal Basis: Strictly necessary for cloud security under ePrivacy regulations.

docs.title: Managing or Revoking Consent
docs.text:
You can revoke your consent at any time by clicking the Manage Cookies link in the site footer, or by clearing your browser cache and cookies for itstck.com.

Once cleared, the cookie consent banner will automatically reappear upon your next page reload.

docs.title: Browser-Level Cookie Management
docs.text:
All modern browsers allow you to block or restrict third-party cookies or block cookies entirely. Blocking technical cookies will not break the primary reading experience on itstck.com.

  • Google Chrome Settings
  • Mozilla Firefox Settings
  • Apple Safari Settings
  • Microsoft Edge Settings

docs.title: 2. Personal Data Processing Overview
docs.text:
ITSTCK operates under a privacy-by-design model. Personal data collection is minimized to what is strictly required for security, optimization, and communication:

  • No Registration Forms: itstck.com does not operate user accounts, membership portals, or automated comment forms.
  • Email Inquiries: If you contact us via email, the information provided (e.g., email address, name, technical query) will be processed solely to address your inquiry.
  • Analytics: Aggregated, anonymized site statistics are captured via Google Analytics only if explicit consent is granted via the site cookie banner.

docs.title: 3. Server Logs & Edge Telemetry
docs.text:
For network security, abuse prevention, and infrastructure debugging, host edge servers automatically record limited HTTP metadata in access logs:

  • IP Address (anonymized where applicable)
  • HTTP request time and protocol version
  • Target URL requested
  • Referrer URL
  • User-Agent string (browser type and OS version)

Retention Period: Server logs are automatically purged within 30 days and are never shared with commercial entities unless mandated by a legal order.

docs.title: 4. Third-Party Service Providers
docs.text: To deliver content reliably and securely, itstck.com integrates the following infrastructure providers:

docs.title: 1. Cloudflare, Inc. (Content Delivery Network & Security)
docs.text: Serves as an edge proxy, providing DNS resolution, SSL encryption, and Web Application Firewall (WAF) protection against malicious traffic. * Privacy Policy: Cloudflare Privacy Policy

docs.title: 2. Google LLC (Anonymized Analytics — Optional)
docs.text: Processes anonymized usage patterns when performance cookies are accepted by the visitor. * Privacy Policy: Google Privacy & Terms

docs.title: 5. Legal Basis for Processing
docs.text:
• Consent (GDPR Art. 6.1.a): Applies to the processing of performance analytics via cookies. Consent can be revoked at any time.
  • Legitimate Interest (GDPR Art. 6.1.f): Applies to technical server logging and threat mitigation required to maintain the availability and security of itstck.com.

docs.title: 6. Your Rights Under GDPR
docs.text:
Under European Data Protection Law (GDPR), you possess the right to:

  • Request Access to your personal data.
  • Request Rectification or correction of incomplete or inaccurate data.
  • Request Erasure ("Right to be forgotten") of personal data.
  • Object to or Restrict processing under specified conditions.
  • Request Data Portability.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us directly at: hello@itstck.com.

You also have the right to lodge a formal complaint with the competent supervisory authority: * Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD): https://www.aepd.es
